newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait bourse to list industrial firm on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait bourse to list industrial firm on Monday.

text.p: The Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE) has approved the listing of the Kuwait Foundry Co, bringing the total number of traded concerns to 64, an official said on Sunday.
Trading in Foundry shares will start on Monday.
The company, established in 1973, reported a net profit rise to 1.174 million dinars ($3.86 million) in 1996 from 753,000 in 1995, figures released by KSE show.
Its assets stood at 5.2 million dinars at the end of 1996 compared to 4.5 million dinars the previous year. It has 10 million issued shares with capital of one million dinars.
The firm's activities include pouring iron and other metals and manufacturing sanitary equipment. It is allowed to invest in financial portfolios.

Trade on the KSE is restricted to nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Foreign residents of the Gulf Arab state can invest through listed funds managed by local firms.
